Inaccuracies in point clouds (spatial position errors, edge ambiguities) can compromise geometry if not weighted correctly [S1].

Thus, the evidence supports the claim that these inaccuracies can compromise geometry and that weighting (or lack thereof/improper handling) is a factor.
